# NCTOH Workshop: Data Analysis Abridged

This module includes summary statistics, chi-square tests, paired tests, and nonparametric methods.

## Summary statistics

```{r, eval=FALSE}
overall_up |> 
  summarise(
    mean_age = mean(current_age),
    sd_age = sd(current_age),
    median_age = median(current_age),
    IQR = IQR(current_age)
  )
```

## Contingency tables and chi-square tests

```{r, eval=FALSE}
table_fuel_inter <- table(overall_up$fuel_type, overall_up$intervention)
chisq.test(table_fuel_inter, correct = FALSE)
```

## Fisher's exact test and McNemar

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Use exact test for small cell counts
fisher.test(table_in_fa)

# McNemar test for paired binary responses
mcnemar.test(table_bfr_aftr)
```

## T-tests and nonparametric tests

```{r, eval=FALSE}
paired_t_test <- t.test(overall_up$sbp_0m, overall_up$sbp_3m, paired = TRUE)

wilcox_paired <- wilcox.test(overall_up$consumption_per_day_0m,
                             overall_up$consumption_per_day_6m,
                             paired = TRUE)

mann_whit <- wilcox.test(consumption_per_day_0m ~ intervention,
                         data = overall_up,
                         correct = FALSE)
```

## ANOVA

```{r, eval=FALSE}
aov_un <- aov(sbp_0m ~ wealth_quintile, data = overall_up)
summary(aov_un)
```

:::
